verdict.rationale: Cerebras has a dedicated rate-limits docs page that describes an uncached TPM limit and how cached tokens don't count against it, and the pricing page says paid self-serve gets '10x higher rate limits than free tier'. That shows documented limits and some tier scaling, but the evidence never shows actual per-model or per-tier numbers. A community report of instantly hitting the requests-per-minute limit suggests limits can be tight in practice, though it doesn't contradict the docs. Missing for 10: concrete published RPM/TPM values per tier and model, documented scaling beyond the free vs. paid 10x claim (e.g., enterprise/dedicated limits), independent corroboration that the docs match observed limits.
